description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android View that displays log messages received via the LogNode interface. It formats log data and displays it in a TextView, supporting chaining with other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that implements LogNode to display log messages received through the LogNode interface, formatting them for readability and managing a chain of log nodes.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a Context object.

methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a Context and AttributeSet.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructor initializing LogView with a Context, AttributeSet, and style.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data and appends it to the LogView, and passes it along the chain of LogNodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the LogView.
